title: Anti
author: reima
rules:
Normal sudoku rules apply: Put the digits 1 to 9 once each in every row, every column, and every 3x3 box.

Antiknight: Any two cells separated by a knight's move in chess cannot contain the same digit.

Antiking: Any two cells separated by a king's move in chess cannot contain the same digit.

Anticonsecutive: Any two orthogonally adjacent cells cannot contain consecutive digits.

Play in SudokuPad.
